caption: The drawing depicts a round object with three short legs, resembling a trivet or stand, shown in three different views on a light beige background. The main object, which occupies the lower half of the drawing, is circular and features an intricate geometric pattern with interlocking curved and straight segments radiating from a central circular motif. The surface design includes rope-like or ridged texturing along the paths of the geometric arrangement. Above the main perspective view, there is a top-down view of the same object, clearly showing the symmetrical pattern within the circle, as well as a side elevation, indicating the object is supported by three evenly spaced cylindrical legs. Below the elevation view is a horizontal scale bar labeled at intervals from 0 to 3, suggesting the measurements are in feet. The drawing is rendered in grayscale with fine shading to indicate the raised texture and depth, and on the lower left, there is a handwritten signature reading “Filippo Perocca.”
title: Pa. German Trivet
